## OWNER SCOPE CHANGE — 2026-11-06 — DEFER AQUORA BLE MIDI UNTIL KIRA-9 HAS A GOOD WORKING BUILD

**This supersedes #31's requirement to finish BLE MIDI in the current AQUORA release. The AQUORA Work build is already running. Do not create a competing build, edit its checkout from a second writer, revoke its lock, or restart its work. The owner will also send this update directly to the existing active Work session.**

- **DEFER BLE MIDI on AQUORA** (radio pairing/discovery, BLE central/peripheral, BLE link protocol, reconnection and wireless AIR handover integration) until KIRA-9 has a sufficiently good working firmware build. This is an **explicit owner-authorized next-version carry-forward, not a release-blocking omission** for the current AQUORA version.
- **KEEP class-compliant bidirectional USB MIDI IN/OUT in the current build**, including clock, transport, notes, controls, master/slave policy, reconnect, loop/note-off safety, and appropriate host/emulator/release tests. Keep the common transport-neutral MIDI architecture so BLE can be added later without rewriting USB support.
- Do not spend the current session implementing, debugging or testing BLE integration. If partial BLE changes already exist, **preserve them safely at a verified checkpoint, avoid disruptive removal, and disable/unexpose unverified BLE features in the release**; do not claim partial BLE as completed. Do not disturb finished source/tests.
- **Keep AIR fully functional**; inactive BLE must not claim the Bluetooth radio, cause AIR disconnection or background scanning. On-device menus/status must truthfully show BLE as unavailable/deferred if present. No misleading scan or pair interface.
- **Issue #1 LED beat pulses** must work from internal tempo and any actually implemented **USB external MIDI clock**; BLE-clock acceptance is deferred with BLE itself.
- Update Issue #32's requirement matrix with **BLE-MIDI: OWNER-AUTHORIZED DEFERRED / future release after KIRA-9 working build** and separately **USB-MIDI: CURRENT-RELEASE REQUIRED**, citing this comment. The release gate must accept this *documented* deferral but still block missing USB support and all other release-critical requirements. Include a clear carry-forward item in NEXT_BUILD_ACTIVE.md.
- Continue the **existing** AQUORA build, code integration, acceptance and publication only when the *revised* software release gates pass. KIRA-9 remains untouched by the AQUORA job. Physical hardware interoperability tests remain owner-unverified.

This is a change of scope, not permission to skip USB MIDI or to publish an incomplete firmware.

## OWNER-APPROVED RELEASE SCOPE CHANGE — #31 (2026-11-06)
The current Work build is **already in progress**. Owner now explicitly authorizes **deferring AQUORA BLE MIDI until KIRA-9 has a good working firmware build**, without restarting or competing with the active build. **Bidirectional USB MIDI remains mandatory in the current AQUORA release.**

Matrix / gate must split #31 into:
- `MIDI-USB`: CURRENT RELEASE REQUIRED: class-compliant IN/OUT, clock/transport/notes/control, safe disconnect/reconnect and tests.
- `MIDI-BLE`: OWNER-AUTHORIZED DEFERRED: no release blocker this version; maintain exact carry-forward dependency on KIRA-9 good working build and preserve any partial work, but don't expose fake or unverified BLE capability.
- `MIDI-AIR`: keep AIR working with radio unused by deferred BLE; preserve eventual mutual-exclusion design.

Reconcile stale #31 owner comments against **newest** scope change, use the current active Work session/lock only, and continue all unrelated planned acceptance and publication gates. PLAY LED tempo synchronization still uses internal tempo and implemented USB clock.

Authoritative owner change: https://github.com/CodingSlapfu/AQUORA/issues/31#issuecomment-6701439630 .
